AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#721 @ 538a0ba4baacefcea5208c0a8a11e87a1a09fb86 — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/0

AUD-SOL-CL3-122, agent 122. Independent T4 delta review; no current-round Opus lens notes, report or comment read. Reused the [prior Sol approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/721#issuecomment-6004991224) only after independent preservation checks.

H721-1, `prisma/schema.prisma:7994–8071`, keeps all three coachless models and main's SchedulingJobLease with separate closing braces; no model field or relation was lost. [Merged schema](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/538a0ba4baacefcea5208c0a8a11e87a1a09fb86/prisma%2Fschema.prisma).

All PR change lines are preserved: the normalized old/new piece diffs differ only in the placement of one empty separator line; migration, rollback and live RLS spec blobs are byte-identical, and size remains 808 lines. [Refreshed piece](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/compare/5cde6253f941112f2d9afbcf572a4da838dbb16a...538a0ba4baacefcea5208c0a8a11e87a1a09fb86).

The migration creates only the three new tables and their constraints/policies; its existing User/CoachPackage/helper dependencies are independent of the seven later main migrations. Keep its reserved name; the exact-head CI log shows `prisma migrate deploy` applying it and all seven later migrations successfully, corroborated by the community job's deploy. [Migration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/538a0ba4baacefcea5208c0a8a11e87a1a09fb86/prisma%2Fmigrations%2F20270301000000_coachless_featured_coach%2Fmigration.sql), [forward deploy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845535/job/112022085808), [community deploy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845528/job/112022085571).

All 11 required checks are completed/success at this exact head, including live RLS, build/test, schema parity and Danger; the coachless live RLS suite actually ran and passed 18/18. [Required check list](https://api.github.com/repos/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks), [CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845528), [schema parity](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845679/job/112022086564), [Danger](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845636/job/112023453023), [live RLS execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37386845528/job/112022085629).

No normal-use A/B defect found. C: none raised in this delta. RUTHLESS SCOPE: frozen edge cases were not investigated.
